title: Shiver
author: Maggie Stiefvater
summary: Grace has been fascinated since childhood by a wolf in the woods behind her Minnesota home. When she meets Sam, a boy who turns into a wolf in the cold, their love is threatened by the coming winter.
readIf: you like atmospheric teen paranormal romance with a quiet, lyrical feel.
skipIf: you want fast action or a gritty take on werewolves.
